docs.title: Welcome to OpenUI
docs.text: OpenUI is the "OpenAPI for Large Action Models". It provides a deterministic way to describe graphical user interfaces so that AI agents and LAMs can interact with them reliably and intelligently.

docs.title: Vision
docs.text: The gap between a Large Action Model (LAM) and a modern web application is often the lack of structured interaction metadata. OpenUI bridges this gap by statically and dynamically analyzing codebases to produce an Agent-UI JSON Standard.

docs.title: Key Concepts
docs.text:
• Agent-UI Standard: A semantic JSON schema describing UI states, elements, and intents.
  • Codebase RAG: A retrieval-augmented engine that "understands" your code better than a simple scraper.
  • Deterministic discovery: Grounding AI "dreams" in actual source code evidence.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Check out the Usage guide to start generating schemas for your own projects.

docs.title: Contributing to OpenUI
docs.text: Thank you for your interest in contributing to OpenUI! This project aims to automate UI discovery through Codebase RAG.

docs.title: How to Contribute
docs.text:
1. Fork the Repository: Create a personal fork of the repo.
  2. Create a Branch: Use a descriptive name for your branch (e.g., feature/custom-framework).
  3. Make Your Changes: Write clean, documented code.
  4. Submit a Pull Request: Provide a detailed description of your changes.

docs.title: Development Setup
docs.text:
1. Install Python 3.10+.
  2. Install dependencies: pip install .
  3. Run the CLI: python openui_gen.py --help
  4. Build locally: python build.py

docs.title: Pull Request Guidelines
docs.text:
• Ensure all tests pass (if applicable).
  • Update the CHANGELOG.md with your changes.
  • Follow the existing code style.

docs.title: OpenUI Developer Guide
docs.text: Welcome to the development community of OpenUI! This document provides information on how to contribute, extend, and improve the OpenUI standard and generator.

docs.title: Project Architecture
docs.text:
OpenUI is built with a modular "RAG-First" architecture:

  • openui_gen.py: Entry point and orchestration.
  • modules/codebase_rag.py: The core ingestion and retrieval engine. Handles multi-framework parsing and chunking.
  • modules/llm_client.py: Interface for local LLM inference (Gemma-3/xLAM).
  • modules/dependency_graph.py: Maps file relationships to provide context for UI discovery.
  • modules/schema_auditor.py: Quantitative analysis tools to verify discovery coverage.
  • modules/semantic_classifier.py: Lightweight NLP for element intent matching.

docs.title: Development Setup
docs.text:
We use Poetry for dependency management.

# Clone the repo
git clone https://github.com/aigamer-dev/openui.git
cd openui

# Install dependencies
poetry install

# Run in development
poetry run python openui_gen.py --target /path/to/test/project --rag

docs.title: Building the CLI
docs.text:
We use a unified build.py script to package the application for all platforms.

python build.py

This uses PyInstaller to create a standalone directory in dist/openui.

docs.title: Contributing Principles
docs.text:
1. Agnosticism: Ensure parsers work across different frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) wherever possible.
  2. Determinism: The standard should be as deterministic as possible. Avoid excessive LLM "hallucination" by grounding results in RAG context.
  3. Privacy: Respect // openui-ignore tags and do not leak sensitive business logic into the UI schema.

docs.title: Roadmap
docs.text:
• [ ] Support for Mobile framework analysis (Flutter, React Native).
  • [ ] Direct integration with Claude "Computer Use" API.
  • [ ] VS Code Extension for real-time agent-ui.json preview.

docs.title: The OpenUI Standard
docs.text: The OpenUI Standard (or agent-ui.json) is designed to be the single source of truth for an application's interface.

docs.title: Schema Overview
docs.text: The schema is composed of:

docs.title: 1. States
docs.text: A "State" represents a logical view or screen in your application (e.g., LoginState, DashboardState).

docs.title: 2. Elements
docs.text: Interactive components within a state (Buttons, Inputs, Links).

docs.title: 3. Intents
docs.text: The semantic meaning of an action (e.g., login, submit_form, navigate_back).

docs.title: Comparison to OpenAPI
docs.text: Feature OpenAPI (REST) OpenUI (LAM) Description API Endpoints UI States & Elements Input JSON/Query Params User Inputs & Events Logic HTTP Methods Interaction Intents Outcome Data Response UI Navigation/Action

docs.title: Generating a Schema
docs.text:
To generate an agent-ui.json for your project:

openui --target /path/to/your/code --rag

docs.title: Directives
docs.text:
Control the generator by adding tags to your source code:

  • // openui-ignore: Excludes a specific line.
  • // openui-ignore-file: Excludes the entire file.
  • @openui_include: Forces the inclusion of a method or class.

docs.title: Manual Overrides
docs.text:
Create an openui.overrides.json in your project root to manually add or modify elements.

{
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "src/Login.js",
      "add_elements": [
        {"label": "Custom Button", "type": "button", "intent": "custom_action"}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
